_meta.description: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA) worker classification for Goa districts. The four worker categories are % of TOTAL workers (main + marginal) and sum to 100. work_participation_rate = total workers / total population x 100.
_meta.source: Census of India 2011, PCA State & District level (NADA catalog 6191, file PC11 PCA district); CD-block PCA for North Goa (catalog 41261) and South Goa (catalog 41262); District Census Handbook Part B North Goa (catalog 369, DH_2011_3001_PART_B_DCHB_NORTH_GOA.pdf, pp.41-46) and South Goa (catalog 371, DH_2011_3002_PART_B_DCHB_SOUTH_GOA.pdf, pp.29-34) for statutory-town rows; DCHB Village & Town Directory (catalog 368) for taluka populations.
_meta.district_note: Census 2011 had two districts. northgoa/southgoa below are the 2011 districts as enumerated (Ponda taluka was then in North Goa). Goa was re-constituted by Revenue Dept Notification No. 16/29/1/2023-Rev-I/3259 dated 31-12-2025 into North Goa (Pernem, Bardez, Tiswadi, Bicholim, Sattari), South Goa (Ponda, Salcete, Mormugao) and Kushavati (Quepem, Sanguem, Dharbandora, Canacona; HQ Quepem). The kushavati entry is NOT a proxy: it is an exact re-aggregation of Census 2011 units that fall wholly inside the new district (Quepem, Sanguem and Canacona CD blocks + Quepem, Curchorem-Cacora, Sanguem and Canacona municipal councils; Dharbandora taluka was carved out of Sanguem in April 2011, after the census reference date, so it is inside the 2011 Sanguem figures). The current_boundaries block re-aggregates North Goa and South Goa to their 2026 extent.
_meta.correction_note: A coordinator message suggested South Goa is now only Salcete and Mormugao. The notification itself (kushavati.goa.gov.in, file 17787404111914.pdf, pp.5-7) lists Ponda under South Goa, and southgoa.nic.in listed 7 talukas incl. Ponda before the split. So current South Goa = Ponda + Salcete + Mormugao. Ponda was moved from North Goa to South Goa in Jan 2015 (Wikipedia, Ponda taluka).

northgoa.source: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (district-level worker classification)

southgoa.source: Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (district-level worker classification)

kushavati.source: Census 2011 PCA re-aggregated: CD blocks Quepem+Sanguem+Canacona (catalog 41262) + 4 municipal councils (DCHB South Goa Part B pp.29-34)
kushavati.note: Kushavati did not exist in 2011 (created 31-12-2025). Figures are an exact re-aggregation of 2011 South Goa units now in Kushavati, not the southgoa proxy.

current_boundaries.note: Census 2011 numbers re-aggregated to the 2026 district boundaries. north_goa = 2011 North Goa minus Ponda taluka (Ponda CD block + Ponda M Cl). south_goa = 2011 South Goa minus Kushavati units plus Ponda taluka.

statewide_2011.literacy_note: literates / population aged 7+ (PCA P_LIT / (TOT_P - P_06)); Census 2011 Goa = 88.70%

talukas._note: Census 2011 population by taluka (sub-district) = sum of village-directory + town-directory populations (DCHB Goa, catalog 368). Totals match state 1,458,545. Dharbandora (notified April 2011) = its 16 villages listed in the 31-12-2025 notification, taken out of 2011 Sanguem. district = current (2026) district; district_2011 = census district.
